metadata.title: Palantir's $442 Billion Valuation Faces a Test

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Artificial intelligence software business Palantir Technologies Inc. (PLTR, Financials) is offering investors additional growth to offset one of the market's wealthiest valuations.
Palantir is worth nearly $442 billion, or 54 times sales, according to a Seeking Alpha analysis. But its recent numbers showed revenue up 93% from a year earlier and an adjusted operating margin of 62 per cent.
The best growth was in the U.S. commercial business, where sales soared 149%. U.S. government revenues grew 90%. The pipeline is growing at the same rate.
U.S. commercial total contracts were a record $2.13 billion, up 153% from a year earlier. That growth may be why Palantir's value has stayed high even as concerns linger that the company has run too far ahead of fundamentals.
The danger is simple: at 54 times revenue, there's not much opportunity for a major downturn, even with great execution. The next question for investors is whether commercial demand can continue to rise quickly enough to justify a price that is already pricing in years of spectacular growth.
